translation:
(Pointing out the root qi is the secret uniquely attained by the Master; it is an argument established from the Five Phases.)

In all the various qi of the viscera and bowels, it is not necessary that kidney water alone bears cold and heart fire alone bears heat. One should know that in each viscus and each bowel, the various qi are harmonious and united; one may disperse and level them. Hence I have often said: in the way of the Five Phases, within yin there is yang, and within yang there is yin. Solitary yin does not grow; lone yang does not complete.
translator_notes: 孤陰不長，獨陽不成 rendered as Solitary yin does not grow; lone yang does not complete.
